title: Value Added Tax (Drugs and Medicines) (Health and Welfare) Order 2026
text:
This measure:

 • amends the VAT zero rate for medicines to include qualifying medicines dispensed by a registered pharmacy technician or by other pharmacy staff under their supervision

 • means that qualifying medicines dispensed under these arrangements receive the same VAT treatment as medicines dispensed by a registered pharmacist
